messages:
viv: Quick scan of staging base-image turned up a couple of hardening gaps: world-writable /tmp, openssl is out-of-date, and several tags lack cosign signatures.

samir: Missing signatures will break our deploy gate. Is cosign failing or was the bake step skipped?

viv: Cosign errors out during bake but the job doesn't fail. After digging, the CI builder lost kms.cryptoSign on the cosign key after last week's RBAC tightening.

nora: Who changed the role? @kevin?

kevin: Yep, I scoped the builder role to reduce broad signing rights. I missed that the bake uses the builder principal. I can add a narrowly scoped kms:Sign for just the cosign key.

samir: Please do. Also add a baked-in verification step so unsigned images fail fast. Suggested snippet: 

```
cosign verify --key k8s://projects/prod/.../cryptoKeys/cosign-key $IMAGE || (echo "unsigned" && exit 1)
```

viv: Agreed. Beyond signing, security wants image-pull events in our audit stream; right now only kubelet start/stop shows up.

nora: That's because our audit sidecar isn't forwarding containerd pull events. We can enable containerd:event forwarding in staging with a narrow filter for pull/create to avoid noise.

kevin: I'll open the RBAC PR with an expiration tag and include rollback instructions (how to remove the binding).

samir: Migration for already-published images: rebuild and repush so provenance stays intact. Re-signing in-place loses build metadata.

viv: I'll schedule the base-image rebuild. Proposed window: Friday 01:00-03:00 PT, canary then promote after checks.

nora: For rollback runbook include: 1) remove KMS binding (`gcloud iam roles remove-iam-policy-binding ...`), 2) mark images quarantined in registry, 3) revert bake pipeline change. Add a note to the PR to call security on the rollback.

attest-bot: scan: staging/base-image:2027-01-14 failed CIS checks (5). https://ci.internal/scans/3399991111

kevin: PR opened, linking after I add the scoped binding. Tagging @viv and @nora for approval.

samir: I'll add the cosign verify to the bake job and add an alert if verify fails more than 3 times in CI.

viv: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after canary. :thumbsup:
